verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS fraud-protection platform supports natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents REST API endpoints, webhooks, SDKs, and device-profiling scripts. Nothing shows a natural-language interface, chat assistant, or conversational command capability, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
